schema.label: 主环半径
schema.description: 以画布半高为 1；0.46 为参考尺度，实际半径随各时点拟合轮廓变化。
schema.descriptionEn: Half-height is 1; 0.46 is the reference scale. The actual radius follows each sampled contour.

schema.label: 亮芯线宽
schema.description: 高斯亮芯的半宽，决定细白光线的锐度；700 px 高时默认约 2.1 px。
schema.descriptionEn: Gaussian core half-width controls sharpness; approximately 2.1 px at a 700 px height.

schema.label: 轮廓起伏
schema.description: 主环低频形变振幅，0 为完美圆。
schema.descriptionEn: Low-frequency contour deformation; 0 produces a perfect circle.

schema.label: 拖影偏移
schema.description: 偏心光带相对主环的位移，保留原片的非对称尾迹。
schema.descriptionEn: Displacement of the off-center light band, preserving the source's asymmetric trail.

schema.label: 旋转环倾角
schema.description: 投影到屏幕的倾角；cos(倾角) 控制椭圆短轴，约 60.7°。
schema.descriptionEn: Projection tilt; its cosine controls the ellipse's short axis. About 60.7° by default.

schema.label: 近场泛光宽度
schema.description: 亮芯外侧的柔和辉光半宽；独立于线宽。
schema.descriptionEn: Soft glow half-width outside the core, independent of line width.

schema.label: 远场光晕宽度
schema.description: 更低频的大范围彩色散射，让亮线融入底色。
schema.descriptionEn: Broad, low-frequency colored scattering blends the bright line into its surroundings.

schema.label: 主环亮度
schema.description: 亮芯增益，过高会使彩色区域趋近白色。
schema.descriptionEn: Bright-core gain; high values push colored areas toward white.

schema.label: 近场泛光强度
schema.description: 彩色高斯泛光的叠加强度。
schema.descriptionEn: Intensity of the added colored Gaussian bloom.

schema.label: 远场光晕强度
schema.description: 大范围散射的强度。
schema.descriptionEn: Intensity of broad scattering.

schema.label: 球心色深
schema.description: 球心蓝紫色对背景的覆盖程度，0 时接近空心。
schema.descriptionEn: Opacity of the blue-violet core over its host; 0 approaches a hollow ring.

schema.label: 拖影强度
schema.description: 主环附近偏心光带的可见度。
schema.descriptionEn: Visibility of the off-center band near the main ring.

schema.label: 扩散环强度
schema.description: 同心外环发光程度，保持次于主环。
schema.descriptionEn: Brightness of concentric outer rings, subordinate to the main ring.

schema.label: 扩散环数量
schema.description: 扩散阶段同时参与计算的同心环数量；默认 3 层。
schema.descriptionEn: Number of concentric rings computed during expansion; default 3.

schema.label: 扩散周期
schema.description: 一圈从起始半径运动到最外缘所需时间。
schema.descriptionEn: Time for one ring to travel from its starting radius to the outer edge.

schema.label: 扩散距离
schema.description: 外环在一个周期内向外移动的径向距离。
schema.descriptionEn: Radial distance traveled by an outer ring during one cycle.

schema.label: 色带角速度
schema.description: 颜色沿主环的流动速度；负值反向，不影响几何旋转。
schema.descriptionEn: Color flow along the ring. Negative values reverse color flow without changing geometry rotation.

schema.label: 环面角速度
schema.description: 交错旋转阶段的几何运动速度。
schema.descriptionEn: Geometry speed during the intersecting-ring phase.

schema.label: 呼吸周期
schema.description: 微弱半径呼吸的一个完整周期。
schema.descriptionEn: Duration of one subtle radius-breathing cycle.

schema.label: 呼吸幅度
schema.description: 相对主环半径的呼吸幅度。
schema.descriptionEn: Breathing amplitude relative to the main ring radius.

schema.label: 青色光
schema.description: 主环青色段和冷色散射。
schema.descriptionEn: Cyan ring segments and cool scattering.

schema.label: 粉色光
schema.description: 主环粉色段与拖影暖色。
schema.descriptionEn: Pink ring segments and warm echoes.

schema.label: 暖白高光
schema.description: 主环最亮部分的暖白色。
schema.descriptionEn: Warm white in the brightest parts of the ring.

schema.label: 球心蓝
schema.description: 球心基础色，通过 coreDepth 混合。
schema.descriptionEn: Base core color, blended through coreDepth.

schema.label: 环境紫
schema.description: 主环外侧低频紫色光场。
schema.descriptionEn: Low-frequency violet light around the main ring.

schema.label: 播放倍率
schema.description: 整个 23.217 s 参考时间轴的速率，1 为原速。
schema.descriptionEn: Speed of the 23.217 s timeline; 1 is the original rate.

schema.label: 渲染像素比
schema.description: Canvas 像素密度上限；较大数值更锐利但增加 GPU 工作量。
schema.descriptionEn: Canvas pixel-density limit. Higher values sharpen the image but increase GPU work.

schema.label: 帧率上限
schema.description: 限制重绘频率；暂停、不可见或减少动态效果时按需绘制。
schema.descriptionEn: Limits redraw frequency. Paused, hidden or reduced-motion scenes render on demand.

evidence: Colors and geometry are reconstructed from L10. Not the proprietary source shader.
